card.name: Words leading into a limit or cap
card.fires_on: Small linking words or nouns right where a limit is about to be stated, such as 'beyond the limits of', 'until X or', 'up to', 'to a maximum', 'too many'. Seen in dosing caps, system errors and form limits.

modes.label: Dose ceilings
modes.description: Linking words just before a maximum dose or stopping condition.
modes.example: increasing at one week intervals by 5 to 10 mg/kg/day until seizures are controlled<< or>> side effects preclude further increases.

modes.label: Maximum or cap wording
modes.description: Words in phrases like 'up to', 'to a maximum', or 'maximum dose' that lead into a numeric bound.

modes.label: Resource limits
modes.description: Words in 'too many' or 'beyond the limits' phrases about capacity or counts.
modes.example: EMFILE Too many file descriptors in use by the process. ENFILE Too many<< files>> open in the system.
